go_base_commit_provenance.prerequisite_baseline_role: merged #2021/#2022 input used to refresh this snapshot; not asserted as the current working-tree HEAD
go_base_commit_provenance.current_source_identity: source_sha256 entries below; runtime HEAD belongs to a separate report

stage_mapping.name: TransactionType
stage_mapping.behavior: Selects the registered type and its merged serialization template.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Unknown-type parsing, every format rejection, and every type dispatch branch require runtime evidence.

stage_mapping.name: Flags
stage_mapping.behavior: The engine checks the universal/type flag mask before type-specific work; handlers may then interpret permitted bits.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Invalid-mask precedence and each type's permitted flag behavior are not established by registry rows.

stage_mapping.name: SourceTag
stage_mapping.behavior: The common template carries the value; selected handlers copy it to created ledger objects.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Only the listed handler families consume it; registry/codec evidence does not cover absent/present apply outcomes.

stage_mapping.name: Account
stage_mapping.behavior: Supplies the source identity used to load state, authorize the signature, charge fees, and apply changes.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Zero-account, missing-account, delegated-account, and pseudo-account paths need explicit cases.

stage_mapping.name: Sequence
stage_mapping.behavior: A nonzero sequence selects the normal proxy and is consumed before the handler runs.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Sequence mismatch, zero sequence, ticket conflict, retry, and sequence increment need execution evidence.

stage_mapping.name: PreviousTxnID
stage_mapping.behavior: It is a common transaction field and also participates in ledger-entry metadata threading; it is not a common transaction engine gate.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Transaction presence, ledger-object stamping, and zero-hash omission are separate cases and are not inferred from format parity.

stage_mapping.name: LastLedgerSequence
stage_mapping.behavior: Preclaim rejects a transaction once the current ledger is past the declared limit.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Boundary equality, expired transactions, and interaction with AccountTxnID need runtime cases.

stage_mapping.name: AccountTxnID
stage_mapping.behavior: A supplied prior hash is checked in preclaim; enabled account tracking is updated during apply.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Mismatch, ticket prohibition, enabled tracking, and successful hash update need separate execution evidence.

stage_mapping.name: Fee
stage_mapping.behavior: The fee is structurally validated, compared with the base fee, charged to the selected payer, and checked by invariants.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Malformed, below-floor, sponsored, retry, tec, and invariant fee outcomes are not implied by success fixtures.

stage_mapping.name: OperationLimit
stage_mapping.behavior: The field is accepted as a common wire/template field; no v3.4.1 common engine check or mutation was found.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Presence, value bounds, signing, and any type-specific interpretation remain unexecuted; do not call it behaviorally covered.

stage_mapping.name: Memos
stage_mapping.behavior: Memo shape, hex, URL-character, and serialized-size checks occur at local submission validation before the consensus engine.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Oversize, malformed child fields, parser boundaries, and local-check cache behavior require direct submission tests.

stage_mapping.name: SigningPubKey
stage_mapping.behavior: The key shape is checked before cryptographic validity; account authorization is checked after ledger state is available.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Empty key, malformed key, master/regular key, delegated signer, and dry-run cases need explicit evidence.

stage_mapping.name: TicketSequence
stage_mapping.behavior: TicketSequence selects and consumes a ticket instead of incrementing the account sequence.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Missing ticket, wrong owner, simultaneous Sequence, recovery, and retry paths need runtime cases.

stage_mapping.name: TxnSignature
stage_mapping.behavior: The signature is checked in the crypto preflight stage and account authorization is checked in preclaim.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Bad signature, canonicality, missing signature, delegated role, and role-prefix amendment paths remain distinct.

stage_mapping.name: Signers
stage_mapping.behavior: Crypto checks run before the ledger signer-list/quorum checks; signer data also changes the signing payload.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Ordering, quorum, unauthorized signer, duplicate signer, delegated signer, and sponsor multisign cases need execution evidence.

stage_mapping.name: NetworkID
stage_mapping.behavior: Legacy networks reject a supplied ID; nonlegacy networks require the matching ID.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Legacy, missing, wrong, matching, and pseudo-transaction exceptions require separate engine runs.

stage_mapping.name: Delegate
stage_mapping.behavior: Delegate changes the signing identity and fee payer after preflight validates the relationship.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Disabled amendment, self-delegate, missing permission, delegate signer, and fee-payer failures need runtime cases.

stage_mapping.name: Sponsor
stage_mapping.behavior: Sponsor fields select preflight, sponsorship-object checks, fee payer selection, reserve mutation, and invariant accounting.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Feature-disabled, malformed combinations, co-signed, pre-funded, reserve, and invariant failure cases need direct evidence.

stage_mapping.name: SponsorFlags
stage_mapping.behavior: The mode bits choose fee or reserve sponsorship and are validated with Sponsor presence and allow-lists.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Zero, masked, unsupported-type, fee, reserve, and changing-sponsorship modes need runtime evidence.

stage_mapping.name: SponsorSignature
stage_mapping.behavior: The nested sponsor signature has a role-specific signing prefix and is checked alongside the transaction signature.
stage_mapping.unexecuted_edges: Missing sponsor, wrong role prefix, single/multisign, canonicality, and feature-era cases need direct comparisons.

evidence.execution_semantics: Rows are source/registry coverage. A row is executed only when a checked-in or explicitly supplied fixture record says so; named tests alone never set executed=true.

checked_in_v4_corpus.corpus_role: committed release corpus; source inventory only
coverage_limits: Bounded common-engine evidence: 118 signed cases across 16 amendment profiles and 12 submitted transaction families; it is not exhaustive transactor or whole-node parity.

Fresh parents persist Amendments and start with an empty queue. Queue evidence includes default network thresholds, five-candidate fee ordering and eviction, and a three-close history with an authenticated empty warmup and exact post-close queue snapshots.
Seed 2016 generates four signed XRP Payment samples only. The bounded Go soak permutes and replays recorded cases; it does not generate fresh oracle inputs at runtime.

Invariant recovery includes malformed Escrow tecINVARIANT_FAILED fee-only recovery and malformed AccountRoot tefINVARIANT_FAILED persistent recovery; the fatal diagnostic is an intentional oracle row.

The six transient open-ledger rows cover four NFTokenAuth and two EscrowToken cases using authenticated rawInsert/rawErase deltas without closing before submission; AMM test-fidelity gap #1498 remains outside this corpus.
Full native cryptography capability, live peer/consensus and protocol-facing RPC parity are not established by this corpus.
